prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Predictions were mostly too high compared to actual noise-corrected results, except for sign_in notification where the prediction was too low.
No effect was seen for home new_flow changes across 2 tests.
No effect was seen for adoption redesign across 2 tests, while another 2 tests made adoption worse.
No effect was seen for finish new_screen in 1 test, while 1 test made finish worse.
Sign-in notification was helpful, but with only 1 test, evidence is still thin.
Evidence is still thin for adoption new_flow, choose_path reorder, sign_in notification, and sign_in reorder, as each has only 1 test.

Measured so far, by kind of change (relative change on the target step):
- adoption, new_flow: -5.7% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- adoption, redesign: -3.9% after noise correction, 4 test(s)
- choose_path, reorder: +0.8% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- finish, new_screen: -1.7% after noise correction, 2 test(s)
- home, new_flow: -2.2% after noise correction, 2 test(s)
- sign_in, notification: +8.0% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- sign_in, reorder: -0.1% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)

Funnel:
- choose_path: 76.2%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 79.3%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 60.9%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 81.3%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 64.8%, median 395s / mean 5815s
- finishing onboarding overall: 19.4%

Return JSON {"scores": [{"index": i, "impact": n, "evidence": n, "confidence": n, "cost": n,
"predicted_lift": x, "note": short}]}

Changes:
0: [sign_in, reorder] Sign-In After Photo Selection Reorder: Moves sign-in screen to take place right after photo selection, allowing users to invest in photo picking before account creation. (why: Sign-in mean time is high (567s) and asking for credentials early before seeing pet options causes drop-off.)
1: [finish, new_flow] Desktop Controls Setup Checklist Flow: Transforms the home welcome screen into an interactive checklist flow explaining pet controls, tray icon commands, and hiding options. (why: Finish conversion drops to 64.8% and support users report post-onboarding confusion on how to control or hide the pet.)
2: [home, notification] Ready Desktop Notification Alert: Adds a desktop notification option and clear status message during pet generation on the waiting screen. (why: Home waiting screen has a high mean time (2336s), causing users to wander off while the pet renders.)
3: [adoption, wait_info] Photo Processing Estimate Display: Displays estimated custom generation processing time and quality guidance on the photo upload screen. (why: Adoption stage suffers from long completion times (mean 1017s) and 3 support tickets about failed/incorrect custom pets.)
4: [choose_path, copy] Path Selection Direct Copy Clarification: Rewrites path selection screen text to explicitly contrast instant pre-made pet adoption against custom photo creation. (why: Choose path stage mean time is 514s, indicating confusion between custom photo generation and standard pet options.)
5: [finish, hint] Desktop Tray Interactivity Hint: Adds a clear hint banner on home_intro instructing users how to interact with the pet via mouse clicks and system tray. (why: Multiple support emails complain about lack of clarity regarding how to control, hide, or talk to the pet after onboarding.)
6: [adoption, incentive] Adoption Certificate Completion Badge: Displays an official adoption verification badge on the certificate screen to encourage users to finish setup. (why: Adoption is the largest bottleneck in the funnel with only 60.9% conversion rate.)
7: [choose_path, layout] Choose Path Split Layout: Changes choose_path layout to split view side-by-side comparison between preset pets and photo customization. (why: Choose path stage has a high mean duration of 514s, suggesting users need clearer visual distinction between paths.)

scores.note: Reordering sign-in showed virtually no effect (-0.1%) in previous testing.
Strong evidence from support, but introducing new flows routinely regresses conversion.
Targets high waiting duration; notification interventions have shown positive results.
Addresses the largest funnel bottleneck and support tickets via low-risk info display.
Low-cost copy clarification targeting path confusion and high drop duration.
Directly resolves user confusion reported in support emails via a simple hint banner.
Targets major adoption drop-off, though incentive badges have unproven lift here.
Split layout aims to clarify path choices, but redesigns carry mixed performance.
